sharedfolder.title: Shared Folders
sharedfolder.pendingNote: The app account has less access than this folder needs. An administrator can grant it
sharedfolder.askAdmin: Ask an administrator to give {account} {access} access to {folder}.
sharedfolder.steps: Ask an administrator to open Control Panel > Shared Folder > {folder} > Edit > Permissions > System internal user > {account} > {access}
sharedfolder.missingHint: {folder} no longer exists. Choose another Shared Folder when you upgrade the app.
sharedfolder.ambiguousHint: More than one volume has a folder named {folder}. Rename one of them.
sharedfolder.allReady: The app account has the access it needs.
sharedfolder.shared_folder_unavailable: The Shared Folder status could not be read
sharedfolder.admin_required: Only a DSM administrator can change this.
sharedfolder.shared_folder_custom_acl: This folder uses advanced permissions. Set the access in Control Panel.
sharedfolder.shared_folder_grant_failed: DSM did not accept the change. Set the access in Control Panel.
sharedfolder.shared_folder_grant_unverif: DSM accepted the change, but the app account still lacks access. Check the folder’s permissions in Control Panel.
